name: recursive-decomposition
description: Decompose dense codebase-wide, multi-document, PDF, and aggregation work even when the input fits the context window, following Recursive Language Models (Zhang, Kraska, Khattab, 2025). Use when the user asks to analyse all files, a whole repo, all docs, large PDFs, or to aggregate or multi-hop across scattered sources. Skip one file, one function, a single needle, or a one-page PDF conversion. Triggers: long context, context rot, large codebase, many files, all files, big document, multi-docume
author: massimodeluisa
